# BoardUI free source

Upstream: https://github.com/BoardUI/boardui
Revision: ec5c5eb3e29c2441be63b9422cd54f411ef23466
Retrieved: 2026-11-06. MIT license preserved in LICENSE.

Selected six base components, shared checkbox glyph, direction helper, class merger, theme and typography. Imports made relative; unused React 19 ref-as-prop forwarding omitted for the existing React 18 host. Styles compiled and scoped to .bui-kit. Original component markup, state behavior and visual tokens retained. No Pro source, logo artwork, or proprietary marketing-site source included.
